parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS).

parameters.name: localId
parameters.description: The local ID of the merge request, which is a sequential ID unique within a repository.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The ID of the organization. You can find the organization ID in the URL of the organization's page on Alibaba Cloud DevOps, such as `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.
